def equals(self, other):
    # Early exit if the other object is not of the same type
    if not isinstance(other, type(self)):
        return False

    self_axes, other_axes = self.axes, other.axes
    # Ensure the same number of axes
    if len(self_axes) != len(other_axes):
        return False
    
    # Check for equality of axes
    if not all(ax1.equals(ax2) for ax1, ax2 in zip(self_axes, other_axes)):
        return False
    
    # Consolidate blocks for accurate comparison
    self._consolidate_inplace()
    other._consolidate_inplace()

    # Check for block count
    if len(self.blocks) != len(other.blocks):
        return False

    # Define a canonicalization function for ordering blocks
    def canonicalize(block):
        return (block.dtype.name, block.mgr_locs.as_array.tolist())

    # Sort the blocks based on canonicalization
    self_blocks = sorted(self.blocks, key=canonicalize)
    other_blocks = sorted(other.blocks, key=canonicalize)

    # Compare each pair of blocks
    return all(block.equals(oblock) for block, oblock in zip(self_blocks, other_blocks))
